title: Assessing the impacts of vegetation cover loss on surface temperature, urban heat island and carbon emission in Penang city, Malaysia
kafy_role_note: joint first author (equal contribution with Z.A. Rahaman and M. Saha)
methods: SVM classification in Google Earth Engine
validation against World Bank emission data
key_result: From 1996 to 2021 forest fell from 47.72% to 30.62% of the land, average LST rose from 22.67 to 30.31 C (0.31 C/year), maximum UHI rose from 1.954 to 3.094, and carbon emission correlated with LST at r = 0.826 to 0.931 (p < 0.001).

method_details.landsat5_radiance: L = ((LMAX - LMIN) / (QCALMAX - QCALMIN)) * (QCAL - QCALMIN) + LMIN; band 6 (10.40 to 12.50 um, 120 m); QCALMAX 255
method_details.landsat8_radiance: L = ML * QCAL + AL - Oi; band 10 (10.6 to 11.19 um, 100 m); Oi = 0.29
method_details.brightness_temperature: BT = K2 / ln(K1 / L + 1) - 273.15; K1, K2 from image metadata
method_details.uhi_formula: UHI = (Ts - Tm) / SD; Ts = LST, Tm = mean LST, SD = standard deviation of LST
method_details.ndvi_classes: six classes named (no vegetation, very poor, poor, normal, good, very good); breaks not given
method_details.carbon_stock_classes: six hierarchical concentration categories (none/very low to very high); breaks not given
method_details.carbon_method: Biomass Carbon Stock Assessment: AGB (kg) = 0.0673 * (rho * DBH^2 * H)^0.976, rho = wood specific gravity (standard) = 1.54 g/cm3; Carbon (kg) = 0.5 * biomass
method_details.carbon_pools_per_class: not reported; no per-class above-ground, below-ground, soil or dead organic pool values in this paper
method_details.emission_calculation: Net carbon emission per study year from the carbon stock maps; mean NDVI, LST and UHI from ArcGIS overlay; validated against World Bank recorded emissions (R2 = 0.9472)
method_details.correlation_setup: Pearson r, N = 46, df = 44, two-tailed; linear regression R2 for CE vs LST 0.866, 0.7961, 0.8423, 0.8391, 0.8014, 0.8029 (1996 to 2021)
method_details.cross_section: four profile lines over the carbon maps (ArcGIS profile graph tool)
